exclusion_reason: No Win32 high-level emulation exists yet to load a redistributable component, and no redistributable-only kit has been assembled or license-checked.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a supported game's exact D3DX, XInput, XAudio, Visual C++, Visual Basic 6, and DirectMusic instrument dependency resolves from a redistributable-only kit, and an unmet dependency is reported.
expected_failing_assertion: The redistributable kit cannot satisfy a supported game's declared runtime dependency from redistributable component alone.
active_gate_evidence: The product reports the exact redistributable dependency a game expects and whether each is redistributable, without bundling a non-redistributable component.
procedure: Resolve a supported game's declared D3DX, XInput, XAudio, Visual C++, Visual Basic 6, and DirectMusic instrument dependency from a redistributable-only kit.
Report any unmet or non-redistributable dependency rather than faking it.
pass_criterion: Every supported redistributable dependency resolves to the correct component and version.
A non-redistributable or missing dependency is reported, not silently substituted.
